source.passage: Each field value must be consistent with the data type of the corresponding field.

wording: The Contract Performance Dataset exporter shall encode every field value consistently with the corresponding field’s declared primitive data type.
condition: When this FFS is invoked for a Contract Performance Dataset.
notes: Operative technical-format obligation conditional on applicable DID/contract invocation; not a universal legal duty.

source.passage: Records may omit values for fields that are nullable but must include values for fields that are not nullable.

wording: The Contract Performance Dataset exporter shall include a value for each nonnullable field in every record.
condition: When this FFS is invoked for a Contract Performance Dataset.
notes: Operative technical-format obligation conditional on applicable DID/contract invocation; not a universal legal duty. Nullable=Conditional is governed by table Use Constraints. Nullable foreign keys and primary-key components remain permitted or required null when those constraints say so.

source.passage: A primary key constraint defines a collection of fields for a table such that the corresponding field values uniquely identify each record. No two records may have the same collection of corresponding field values.

wording: The Contract Performance Dataset exporter shall assign a unique primary-key field-value combination to every record within each table that has a declared primary-key constraint.
condition: When this FFS is invoked for a Contract Performance Dataset.
notes: Operative technical-format obligation conditional on applicable DID/contract invocation; not a universal legal duty. Uniqueness is over the declared key tuple, including any null components allowed or required by the table. Do not invent SQL-style mandatory-nonnull primary-key semantics. String key comparisons are case insensitive under 2.1.6.

source.passage: A foreign key constraint defines a correspondence between a field in one table and a field in another table such that the field value for each record in the former must match the field value for some record in the latter.

wording: The Contract Performance Dataset exporter shall set every nonnull foreign-key field value to a value present in the referenced field of the referenced table.
condition: When this FFS is invoked for a Contract Performance Dataset; when the foreign-key field is not null.
notes: Operative technical-format obligation conditional on applicable DID/contract invocation; not a universal legal duty. Null is permitted for nullable foreign keys and required by several table conditions; 2.1.2 and each table control applicability. String key comparison is case insensitive under 2.1.6; enumerations are implicit lookup tables under 2.1.4.

source.passage: The following control characters are prohibited in all string values: (U+0000–U+0008), (U+000B– U+000C), (U+000E–U+001F), (U+007F).

condition: When this FFS is invoked for a Contract Performance Dataset.
notes: Operative technical-format obligation conditional on applicable DID/contract invocation; not a universal legal duty.

source.passage: String values used as ID’s are further limited to a character set representing common printable characters (U+0020–U+007E).

condition: When this FFS is invoked for a Contract Performance Dataset.
notes: Operative technical-format obligation conditional on applicable DID/contract invocation; not a universal legal duty. Explicit restrictive statement, also governed by primitive-type consistency in 2.1.1.
